After reset the read data register is zero, leds are off, segments_n and digit_enable_n are all high (blank), and the debounced button levels and the switch sample are zero until the first clocks after release.'
- about: uart_pins
  text: 'ARCHITECTURE.md lists uart_rx on D4 and uart_tx on C4. design.xdc, which was built, puts uart_rx on C4 and uart_tx on D4, as spec.yaml does.'
- about: pwm_rate
  text: 'Spec disagrees with the RTL. spec.yaml''s resolved answer describes 1024 system-clock cycles per PWM period (a prescale) at about 97.7 kHz, but its timing section and the RTL use a 256-cycle period with the phase counter advancing every clk (about 390.625 kHz); there is no prescale in t1_led_dimmer_counter.sv. - about: brightness_source
  text: 'The BRIGHTNESS register always returns the stored UART value, never the switch value. In switch mode (CONTROL bit 0) the switches set the active brightness for the LEDs and the two brightness digits, and the stored value is neither overwritten nor shown.'
- about: unmapped_access
  text: 'Register window accesses use the exact byte offset. Writes to DESIGN_ID, the read-only registers, reserved offsets and non-multiples of four are ignored, and the shell still answers status OK echoing the data, so a host cannot see the write was dropped. Reads of reserved or unaligned offsets return zero. Reads have no side effects, and press counts are not cleared by reading.'
- about: partial_writes
  text: 'COUNTER keeps only the low 16 bits and BRIGHTNESS the low 8 bits of a write. CONTROL stores all 32 written bits and reads them back, although only bits 0 and 1 have any effect. Narrow registers read zero-extended.'
- about: same_cycle_priority
  text: 'Counter updates: a UART write to COUNTER in the same cycle beats any button event on the counter, then centre-clear beats up and down, and a simultaneous up and down event cancels. The press counts are incremented for every debounced press regardless of these priorities. Up/down events during a hold do not repeat; only the debounced rising edge counts.'
- about: switch_sampling
  text: 'Switches pass through one register stage (switches_sync), while buttons pass through two. The spec asks for synchronisation without saying how many stages, so a switch change can in principle be captured metastable. The input paths are marked false-path in design.xdc.'
- about: display_blanking
  text: 'AN5 and AN4 are enabled in turn but with all segments off, and the decimal point is never lit. CONTROL bit 1 set turns every digit enable off.'
- about: latency_count
  text: 'Counted from the RTL: a button event is raised when the debounce counter reaches DEBOUNCE_CYCLES minus one, after the two synchroniser flops, and the counter register changes on the next edge. leds, segments_n and digit_enable_n are registered, adding one more clock. A UART read captures win_rdata from the register that was loaded in the win_rd cycle. A full display frame takes 8 times DISPLAY_SCAN_CYCLES clocks, as promised. UART response time was not counted.'
- about: assumption_shell_window
  text: 'The Designer decoded the shell window as a 7-bit offset (host address 0x80 plus the offset), as ARCHITECTURE.md describes, and relied on the shell''s fixed 100000-cycle frame timeout rather than a parameter.'

- about: reset_values
  text: Spec disagrees with the RTL. spec.yaml's register map and the assumptions give zero for brightness and control with
    the display enabled, while its resolved answer says brightness resets to 0x40 and CONTROL to 0x2. t1_led_dimmer_counter.sv
    resets counter, BRIGHTNESS, CONTROL and the three press counts to zero, so the display starts enabled and the UART brightness
    source is selected. After reset the read data register is zero, leds are off, segments_n and digit_enable_n are all
    high (blank), and the debounced button levels and the switch sample are zero until the first clocks after release.
- about: uart_pins
  text: ARCHITECTURE.md lists uart_rx on D4 and uart_tx on C4. design.xdc, which was built, puts uart_rx on C4 and uart_tx
    on D4, as spec.yaml does.
- about: pwm_rate
  text: Spec disagrees with the RTL. spec.yaml's resolved answer describes 1024 system-clock cycles per PWM period (a prescale)
    at about 97.7 kHz, but its timing section and the RTL use a 256-cycle period with the phase counter advancing every
    clk (about 390.625 kHz); there is no prescale in t1_led_dimmer_counter.sv. Duty is brightness/256 for brightness below
    255 (0 is always off), and 255 bypasses the PWM and is continuously on.
- about: brightness_source
  text: The BRIGHTNESS register always returns the stored UART value, never the switch value. In switch mode (CONTROL bit
    0) the switches set the active brightness for the LEDs and the two brightness digits, and the stored value is neither
    overwritten nor shown.
- about: unmapped_access
  text: Register window accesses use the exact byte offset. Writes to DESIGN_ID, the read-only registers, reserved offsets
    and non-multiples of four are ignored, and the shell still answers status OK echoing the data, so a host cannot see
    the write was dropped. Reads of reserved or unaligned offsets return zero. Reads have no side effects, and press counts
    are not cleared by reading.
- about: partial_writes
  text: COUNTER keeps only the low 16 bits and BRIGHTNESS the low 8 bits of a write. CONTROL stores all 32 written bits
    and reads them back, although only bits 0 and 1 have any effect. Narrow registers read zero-extended.
- about: same_cycle_priority
  text: 'Counter updates: a UART write to COUNTER in the same cycle beats any button event on the counter, then centre-clear
    beats up and down, and a simultaneous up and down event cancels. The press counts are incremented for every debounced
    press regardless of these priorities. Up/down events during a hold do not repeat; only the debounced rising edge counts.'
- about: switch_sampling
  text: Switches pass through one register stage (switches_sync), while buttons pass through two. The spec asks for synchronisation
    without saying how many stages, so a switch change can in principle be captured metastable. The input paths are marked
    false-path in design.xdc.
- about: display_blanking
  text: AN5 and AN4 are enabled in turn but with all segments off, and the decimal point is never lit. CONTROL bit 1 set
    turns every digit enable off.
- about: latency_count
  text: 'Counted from the RTL: a button event is raised when the debounce counter reaches DEBOUNCE_CYCLES minus one, after
    the two synchroniser flops, and the counter register changes on the next edge. leds, segments_n and digit_enable_n are
    registered, adding one more clock. A UART read captures win_rdata from the register that was loaded in the win_rd cycle.
    A full display frame takes 8 times DISPLAY_SCAN_CYCLES clocks, as promised. UART response time was not counted.'
- about: assumption_shell_window
  text: The Designer decoded the shell window as a 7-bit offset (host address 0x80 plus the offset), as ARCHITECTURE.md
    describes, and relied on the shell's fixed 100000-cycle frame timeout rather than a parameter.
